title: Platform
description: Either (a) a distribution channel a single venture reaches customers through (App Store, Marketplace, Retail...), or (b) shared internal infrastructure that provides capabilities to many ventures (type=Shared Infrastructure). These are deliberately kept in one schema with a type discriminator rather than two, since both are 'platform' entries a repository or venture can point at — but they use different relationship fields below, so do not conflate a distribution-channel record with a shared-infrastructure record.

type.description: Platform category. Use 'Shared Infrastructure' for internal platforms like IZA-OS/Civilization OS/VEX/AVS that provide capabilities to many ventures, rather than App Store/Web/Marketplace/etc which describe a single venture's distribution channel.

venture.description: For distribution-channel types only: the single venture this platform entry belongs to. Leave null for Shared Infrastructure types — use serves_ventures instead.

repository.description: Repository identifier that implements this platform, if applicable

provides_capabilities.description: For Shared Infrastructure types: capability identifiers this platform provides

serves_ventures.description: For Shared Infrastructure types: venture identifiers that consume this platform. Distinct from 'venture' (singular, distribution-channel ownership).

compound_use_score.description: 0-100. Higher = used by more ventures with more dependencies pointing at it = more engineering attention deserved. Null until scored.
